correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Kummer carry proof with K=p^a b-1. For j=floor(log_p b)<a, three exhaustive cases v_p(q-1)<=j, j<v_p(q-1)<a, v_p(q-1)>=a force at least a-j carries. The explicit t=p^a(1+((b-1) mod p^j)) gives a-j carries by the split b-1=s p^j+r; b=1 follows from the special prime-power carry pattern. For j>=a Guo et al. Lemma 9 supplies an actual zero-valuation binomial. To exclude all other prime factors, integer-valued degree-k polynomial F(X)=binom(kX,k) and Newton difference F(0)=sum_h(-1)^h Delta^h F(1) yield r|(k+1) for any common prime r. Independently recomputed 73 direct integer gcds n=3..75 from all binomials. Exact integers and finite checks corroborate, not replace, the uniform proof.
